description: Download a completed clip (kind "clip", default; same as `clipugc videos download <id>`) or a completed merged ad (kind "ad"; same as `clipugc ads download <adId>`) to a local mp4 file. Pass an absolute output path; missing parent directories are created. Costs no credits. Fails if the video has not completed yet.

id.description: Clip or ad id, as returned by other tools (numbers are fine as strings).

kind.description: "clip" (default) for a character video id, "ad" for a merged_video_id.

output.description: Destination file path (same as --output). Default: clipugc-video-<id>.mp4 or clipugc-ad-<id>.mp4 in the server's working directory.

name: download_video
title: Download a clip or ad
